title: Design System Consumer Config
description: The consumer-side configuration written by `pnpm ds:connect` at <consumer-root>/.design-system/config.json. It records which installed @prism-system design system a product repository consumes, the exact resolved version, the public manifest subpath, and strict mode. It contains no component source or styling; the installed package remains the source of truth.

package.description: The supported design system package the product consumes.

version.description: Exact resolved version; equal to the installed package.json version and the shipped manifest version.

manifest.description: The public export subpath that resolves to the shipped design-system.json manifest.

strict.description: Strict usage mode. Defaults to true; layout is allowed, visual language overrides are not.
